title: From Matching Models to Recruiting Agents: A Systematized Narrative Review of AI Recruitment Systems, Evaluation, and Governance

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual audits replacing names or demographic signals in resumes, evaluating direct scoring under gender perturbations, detecting gendered wording in job advertisements, and assessing end-to-end pipeline aggregate parity.
Counterfactual name substitution while holding qualifications constant, and evaluating direct scoring and ranking changes under racial perturbations.
Analyzing sensitivity and penalty rates in resume screening, and assessing disclosure paradoxes where multimodal AI tools penalize candidates based on voice, gaze, affect, and outlier assumptions.
End-to-end observational audits of public-employment pipelines to identify disparate impacts that are often masked by aggregate metrics.
Pipeline audits evaluating salary-level disparities across candidate-vacancy records and hiring outcomes.
Evaluating representation disparities to see if parsing or normalization loses evidence across different document styles, non-native languages, or cross-lingual variations.
